text:
devon: FYI spotted a perf regression onboarding mixtral7b converted from HF safetensors — latency spikes + batcher oscillation on 4096-seq workloads. KV cache eviction rate shoots up. Posting profiler skim below.
anya: can you share the exact conversion steps and the HF config you used?
devon: ran: `python tools/convert_hf.py --src mixtral7b.safetensors --out mixtral7b.rw --quant 4bit` — conversion reported no errors. HF config file was missing an explicit `num_attention_heads` field (had `n_head`).
devon: profiler snippet:
```
batcher: avg latency 320ms -> 1.2s after steady state
kv_cache: evictions/sec 45 (baseline 2)
kernel_select: toggling between matmul_int8 (optimized) and f32fallback every few batches
shapes observed: key tensor shape (bs, heads, seq, head_dim) expected head_dim=64 but got 128
```
kevin: head_dim mismatch explains kernel fallback — optimized kernels require exact (heads, head_dim) layout. HF configs are wildly inconsistent: `n_head`, `n_heads`, `num_attention_heads`. Parser needs a fallback chain.
maria: also seeing safetensors metadata axes varying — sometimes metadata gives packed dims, sometimes separate heads/head_dim. Conversion script assumed separate axes which caused a silent reshape.
devon: repro steps to trigger regression: serve converted model, hammer with 16 concurrent requests, seq lengths ramp 32->1024, warmup 2k tokens. Batcher window oscillates and latency spikes after a few minutes. Flamegraph: https://perf.redwood/flow/2512345678 (private).
kevin: short-term mitigation: add strict validation that `hidden_size == num_attention_heads * head_dim` and that result is integer. If not, fail conversion. I'll draft parser change.
anya: +1 on failing early. Also add a safetensors metadata check: ensure `metadata.get('axes')` matches expected ordering or warn if ambiguous. We had one model with `axes: ["vocab","channels"]` which is clearly wrong for attention weights.
maria: suggestion for conversion: explicitly compute head_dim = hidden_size // num_heads, then run `assert hidden_size % num_heads == 0` and reshape weights accordingly. Emit a warning if computed head_dim != metadata head_dim.
kevin: PR incoming (wip) — will: 1) fallback chain for head field names, 2) strict integer check + assert, 3) runtime kernel selection will prefer kernels keyed by (head_dim, kv_dim) exact match and log fallback reasons. Will add unit tests with malformed configs.
ci-bot: CI queued for branch kevin/validate-heads: https://ci.redwood/runs/kevin-validate-heads-2512345678 (unit+integration).
sre-bot: if parser change is merged, plan a canary rollout. Also add an alert rule: if `kernel_fallback_rate > 5%` for 5m, page eng-runtime.
devon: thanks — I'll re-run conversion against the archived mixtral7b and post perf numbers. For immediate triage I put a small script in /tmp that fails on mismatch: `python -c "assert hidden_size % num_heads == 0"` and returns nonzero on failure.
maria: perfect — once PR lands we'll add a small migration note for models converted before the checks.
kevin: will include migration note + conversion tool flag `--force-head-dim` to handle messy legacy models (but it will print a big warning and require explicit opt-in).
devon: cool, keep me in the loop. I can help validate on the affected infra nodes tomorrow. :thumbsup:
